newsitem.title: USA: Technitrol to buy Germany's Doduco.
newsitem.headline: Technitrol to buy Germany's Doduco.

text.p: Technitrol Inc said Monday it had agreed to acquire the operating assets of Doduco GmbH's metallurgical business in Pforzheim, Sinsheim and Huchenfeld, Germany, and the capital stock of Doduco Espana in Madrid.
The purchase price is about $22 million in cash, Technitrol said.
Also, Technitrol will lease from a third party about $18 million of precious metals previously owned by Doduco and used in its operations.
Technitrol said funding for the transaction is being provided by bank debt and cash on hand.

Doduco, which has operated in bankruptcy since June, is one of the largest producers of electrical contacts, contact materials, thermostatic bimetals and precision contact sub-assemblies made from precious and non-precious metals.
Noting that Doduco is operating profitably, Technitrol said the assets being purchased are expected to have revenues this year of $159.7 million and produce a net profit of $4 million.
Technitrol purchased Doduco's U.S. operations in 1992.
